operating_notes.text: BSE fined the company for non-compliance with LODR Regulations 17(1), 17(2A), 18(1) and 19(1)/19(2) for the quarter ended 31 March 2026; the company has sought a waiver.

timeline.summary: Balmer Lawrie Investments reported Q1FY27 results showing a decline in standalone revenue and profit, while consolidated performance remained stable.

On 13 August 2026, Balmer Lawrie Investments' board took on record BSE fines for LODR Regulations 17, 18 and 19 non-compliance in Q4FY26, attributed the lapses to ministry-controlled board appointments, and confirmed its waiver representation to the exchange.
On 26 August 2026, Balmer Lawrie Investments disclosed a BSE fine of ₹9.78 lakh for Q1FY27 board composition non-compliance under LODR Regulations.
Balmer Lawrie Investments filed the notice for its 25th AGM and Annual Report for FY2025-26 on 27 August 2026.
Balmer Lawrie Investments Ltd’s 25th AGM (21-09-2026) passed all 6 resolutions via e-voting, including audited FY2026 financials adoption with 99.9979% approval.
